fields.label: Sales Channel
fields.description: Backend-specific Sales Channel id or name. Resolved against the channel doctype of the chosen backend at sync time.

fields.label: Visibility
fields.options:
All (30)
Linked Only (20)
Search Only (10)
Hidden (0)
fields.description: Shopware-only knob. Medusa treats anything other than ``Hidden (0)`` as visible.

fields.label: Link only (don't unlink existing)
fields.description: When set, the sync only ADDS items to this backend category. Items already in the backend that aren't in the resolved set are left alone. Use this when adopting a manually-curated category.

fields.label: External ID
fields.description: Backend Category id, set after the first successful sync.

fields.label: Last Heartbeat At
fields.description: Updated at the start of every sync attempt. recover_stale_targets sweeps rows stuck in 'running' past the heartbeat timeout.

fields.label: Last Error
fields.description: Short message; full traceback lands in Ecommerce Integration Log.
